It is made of animal hide and sturdy wood and is best suited to defending against weak monsters or animals.|Inventory|TotK}} Traveler's Shields go unnamed in {{AoC}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 4 |durability = 12 |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Traveler's Shield}} Traveler's Shields are simple, mid-grade [[Shield]]s. They are beloved by many travelers and are used for protection against weak monsters and [[Creature]]s. The Traveler's Shield is also a part of an unnamed set of equipment used by [[Link]] in promotional media, alongside a [[Soldier's Broadsword]] and a [[Traveler's Bow]]. There are many places to find a Traveler's Shield, most notably at enemy camps on the beaches surrounding [[Hyrule Field]] and [[West Necluda]]. They are also given out by [[Selmie]] as a reward for completing the [[Shield-Surfing (Mini-Game)|Shield-Surfing]] [[Mini-Game]] with a time between 2:30 and 2:45.{{Cite|A shiny new record deserves a shiny new shield. Here y'go!|Selmie|BotW}} The following [[amiibo]] have a chance to spawn a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a Traveler's Shield when they are scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]: * {{SSB}} Series [[Link]] amiibo * {{TLoZ Series}} Series [[Link]] ({{TLoZ}}) amiibo * {{TLoZ|-}} Series [[Toon Zelda]] ({{TWW}}) amiibo * {{TLoZ|-}} Series [[Link]] ({{TP}}) amiibo * {{TLoZ|-}} Series [[Link]] ({{SS}}) amiibo * {{BotW}} Series [[Princess Zelda|Zelda]] amiibo * {{BotW|-}} Series [[Urbosa]] amiibo Being made from [[Wood]], Traveler's Shields will start to burn if exposed to a [[Fire]]. Since they are not made of metal, they do not conduct [[Electricity]] or attract [[Lightning]] when equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]], and can not be manipulated using the [[Magnesis]] Rune. When dropped into [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], Traveler's Shields will float. Traveler's Shields belong to the [[Traveler's Gear]] archetype of equipment, which are all said to be used to defend travelers throughout [[Hyrule Kingdom]].{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher=
